picks.editorial_note: A £20m MRC-funded hub led by Cambridge will fuse stem-cell-derived tissue models with AI to speed up and de-risk early drug development — a major national investment aimed at a persistent bottleneck in medicine.

picks.editorial_note: SRI, Mayo Clinic, and the University of Florida are jointly building an ARPA-H-funded AI system that guides healthcare workers through procedures like blood draws and intubation using smart glasses — a tangible step toward AI-augmented clinical care.

picks.editorial_note: UC Riverside researchers secured DOE Genesis Mission Phase I funding to apply AI to quantum error correction and cross-lab data sharing, part of a new national push to accelerate scientific discovery with AI.
picks.title: UCR researchers join DOE effort to speed scientific discovery

picks.editorial_note: HKU and nearly 20 global universities, including UC Berkeley and Tsinghua, launched RoboDojo, the first unified benchmark for embodied AI robot manipulation — a significant step toward standardized global evaluation in robotics.
